notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The update includes:
- all challenge modes available from the start
- the tracks Canyon 1 and Metropolis 1 also available from the start besides City Limits 1
- small changes to tracks order in career mode for tier 1 and tier 2 to make it more fun
- implemented an input to look back (default is Left Shift / controller Y button)
- minor gameplay improvements
